mapper.select: SELECT c.ch_level AS chLevel, c.ch_exp AS chExp, c.user_num AS userNum, cg.cg_name AS cgName, cg.cg_img AS cgImg, (SELECT MIN(he_exp) FROM highest_exp WHERE he_level > c.ch_level) AS nextLevelExp FROM `character` c JOIN character_grow cg ON c.cg_num = cg.cg_num WHERE c.user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exp_history (ch_num, ed_num, eh_exp, eh_type_name, eh_created_at) VALUES (#{chNum}, #{edNum}, #{ehExp}, #{ehTypeName}, NOW())
